name: ok-plugins
description: The ok-* suite's user-scoped plugins: the ok front door, which vendors the suite's skill families into each project, and the personal ok-conduct output style.

plugins.name: ok-conduct
plugins.description: The Fall Guy Consulting code of conduct as a personal, user-scoped output style — installed by a user for themselves, never vendored into a project and never installed by the suite's front door

plugins.name: ok
plugins.description: The ok-* suite's front door and sole administrator — /ok carries the suite's skill families (planner, plumbline, workspaces) as payload and administers each project's presence in one process: install, converge, repair; family knowledge lives at each family's conventional administration surfaces
